findings: fibre-silt and gel-fibre share a forked linear silhouette, but the first has a granular continuous floor and narrow bare fibres; the second has a broad raised infill face and visible cleaved depth. They are locally distinguishable beyond hue, while remaining a weak neighbor pair.
pale-sail shows folded angular facets and a continuous jagged lip; resin-hollows shows concave floor channels and a thick curved rim. These views clearly differ in visible geometry.
Illuminated near edges remain legible in the four sampled views. Black off-view regions were not identified as erosion from appearance alone.
limitations: Four static actual-play frames, not all12 trips or full world routes. Positions, seeds, facing and equipment differ.
No dynamic, sound, novice-readability or fatigue approval.
